description: Scientists suggest an ultra-high-energy neutrino detected by KM3NeT detector may come from a primordial black hole explosion, hinting at new physics involving dark charge and the early universe.
title: Ultra-High-Energy Neutrino Detected Beneath Mediterranean Sea Baffles Scientists

description: The global smartphone market experienced a 6 percent year-over-year (YoY) decline in shipments in Q1 2026, as per a new report by Counterpoint Research. Apple led the global smartphone market, driven by strong iPhone 17 demand. Samsung followed with a 20 percent market share. Xiaomi retained third place, while Oppo and vivo held fourth and fifth positions, respectively.
title: Apple Took Top Spot as Global Smartphone Shipments Fell 6 Percent YoY in Q1 2026: Counterpoint

description: The House of the Spirits is a generational saga of love, power and rebellion in a patriarchal family.
title: The House of the Spirits OTT Release Date Revealed: What You Need to Know About its Cast, Plot, and Streaming Details

description: Huawei Pura 90 Pro and Pura 90 Pro Max will launch in China on April 20, with pre-orders already live. The phones will be available in multiple colour options and storage variants up to 16GB + 1TB. Both models feature a triangular rear camera module with three lenses. They are expected to run on the Kirin 9030 Pro chipset and HarmonyOS 6. Huawei may also include HyperSpace Memory technology to improve multitasking and background app performance.
title: Huawei Pura 90 Pro, Puro 90 Pro Max Design, Colourways, RAM and Storage Configurations Confirmed

description: Sangamarmar is a heartfelt romantic drama about love, sacrifice, and time.
title: Sangamarmar Streaming on JioHotstar: Cast, Story, Release Date, and More

description: The Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro offers some flagship-grade features. The earbuds support AAC, SBC, SSC (Samsung Seamless Codec), SSC-UHQ, and LC3. The earbuds also come with some intuitive head gestures. With this, you can nod to accept or reject a call. The company also claims that the new Buds 4 Pro feature enhanced two-way speakers and a six-microphone setup.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro Review: A Balanced Upgrade

description: In this article, we’ve rounded up some of the best laser printers available in India in 2026 for students. Few devices combine printing, scanning, and copying into a single unit. Some advanced models offer faxing as well. Our finds include the popular and reliable options from brands like HP, Canon, Brother, and more. Readers can compare the features, specifications, and pricing to find the printer that best suits their needs.
title: Best Laser Printers Available in India for Students

description: Hong Kong has granted its first stablecoin issuer licences to HSBC and a Standard Chartered-led venture, marking a key milestone under its new regulatory framework. The move reflects a cautious approach, favouring institution-backed players while setting strict rules for reserves, governance, and compliance in the evolving digital asset market.
title: HSBC, Standard Chartered-Led Group Bags First Stablecoin Issuer Licenses in Hong Kong

description: Sony pictures has signed a deal with Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein, co-directors of last year’s Final Destination Bloodlines, to direct a Metal Gear Solid film adaptation. The project is set to be produced by Avi Arad and Ari Arad. It's unclear if Hideo Kojima will be involved with the project.
title: Metal Gear Solid Film Adaptation From 'Final Destination' Directors in the Works at Sony

description: OnePlus has started teasing the launch of a new Ace series phone. A video teasing the upcoming smartphone was shared by OnePlus China President Li Jie Louis on a Chinese microblogging platform. The tech firm wrote that the “OnePlus Ace New Product Month officially begins” (translated from Chinese), hinting that the upcoming Ace series phone could be launched later this month. While the name of the phone, along with other details, remains under wraps, a report claims that the teaser belongs to the rumoured OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Launch Seems Imminent as Company Starts Teasing Arrival of a New Ace Model

description: Infinix confirmed the colour options and pre-booking offers of the Note 60 Pro ahead of its April 13 India launch. It will feature a 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED display with 144Hz refresh rate and run on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset with up to 8GB extended RAM. The phone will include an Active Matrix LED system, vapour chamber cooling, and a 6,500mAh battery with 90W charging. It will also offer dual cameras, JBL-tuned speakers, and an IP64 rating.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Key Specifications, Features Confirmed Days Ahead of India Launch

description: Mudborn is a Mandarin-language horror film that follows a game developer who unknowingly brings home a cursed clay doll. As strange and terrifying events unfold, his pregnant wife becomes entangled in the mystery.
title: Mudborn Now Available For Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: NASA’s Artemis 2 mission has entered its last full day in space. The Orion spacecraft is speeding towards the Earth, and is scheduled to make a splashdown in less than 24 hours. The US space agency’s first crewed mission in 50 years is expected to bring new insights into deep space missions and will pave the way for future crewed missions to Mars.
title: NASA’s Artemis 2 Crew to Spend Last Full Day in Space Before Earth Re-Entry

description: Google on Friday announced the rollout of agentic capabilities in AI Mode in India. The update introduces the ability to discover and book restaurant reservations directly through Search. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, it is aimed at achieving a practical use case by helping users complete real-world tasks more efficiently. Google claims the new agentic capabilities can handle multi-step queries and reduce the effort required to search across platforms manually.
title: Google Rolls Out AI Mode Agentic Features in India, Enables Restaurant Booking via Search

description: Pearl Abyss has announced a host of new planned updates for Crimson Desert. In a dev update shared Friday, the South Korean studio shared new features, content, and improvements currently in development. New updates will be rolled out in a gradual manner from April through June, the studio announced.
title: Crimson Desert to Get Difficulty Settings, Boss Rematches and More Improvements in Upcoming Patches

description: Instagram has announced the rollout of a new feature that allows users to edit their comments. The move, announced on Friday, addresses a long-standing limitation on the social media app. The Meta-owned platform said that the feature is being rolled out globally. It lets users make changes to their comments shortly after posting, making it easier to fix typos or refine responses. While Instagram has supported editing posts for some time, comments were uneditable, that is, until now.
title: Instagram Adds Support for Editing Comments Within 15-Minute Window

description: Oppo Pad Mini has appeared on Geekbench ahead of its April 21 China launch, revealing key performance details. The tablet, model OPD2515, is expected to use a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip with scores of 2,762 single-core and 9,037 multi-core. It may feature 12GB RAM and Android 16. Leaks suggest an 8.8-inch LTPO OLED display with 144Hz refresh rate, a slim design, and an 8,000mAh battery with 67W charging. Oppo will launch the tablet alongside other devices.
title: Oppo Pad Mini Visits Geekbench Database With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Chip, 12GB RAM

description: Poco M8s has received certification from Thailand's National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC). The listing shows the handset with model number Poco 26067PC09G. It is confirmed to offer 5G connectivity. The Poco M8s is likely to sit below the Poco M8 in the market. The latter was launched in India in January this year with a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset and a 5,520mAh battery.
title: Poco M8s Listed on Thailand's NBTC Database Ahead of Anticipated Global Launch

description: Operation Atlantic, involving agencies from the UK, US, and Canada, has frozen $12 million linked to crypto phishing scams. The initiative identified over 20,000 victims and highlighted the growing threat of approval phishing attacks. Authorities are increasing international cooperation to tackle organised digital asset fraud.
title: UK NCA-Led Operation Atlantic Freezes $12 Million Funds Tied to Approval Phishing Scams

description: MediaTek is said to be working on the Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, which will compete with Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset and the standard Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC. A new leak suggests that the  Dimensity 9600 Pro will offer a peak speed of 5GHz. It will reportedly be manufactured using TSMC’s advanced N2P (2nm) process and support LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5.0 storage.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Leak Suggests 'Nearly' 5GHz Peak Clock Speed, New CPU Architecture

description: Vivo T5 Pro 5G will be powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, the Chinese smartphone revealed on Friday. Additionally, the company has confirmed that the phone will be equipped with a vapour chamber (VC) cooling solution, featuring a 7,000 sq mm heat dissipation area. The company claims that the handset will boast the “biggest VC cooling system” in the Rs. 37,000 price segment in India. The price range is in line with the earlier reports, suggesting that the top-end configuration could cost Rs. 36,999.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G Price Range Revealed; Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 Chipset Confirmed

description: Bitcoin traded near $72,000 on April 10, facing resistance amid rising ETF outflows and macro uncertainty. Analysts noted that while accumulation trends remain intact, weak institutional conviction and mixed sentiment are keeping the market range-bound. Altcoins showed limited movement, with investors closely watching inflation data and Fed signals for the next directional cue.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Remain Range-Bound as ETF Outflows and Macroeconomic Pressure Limit Upside

description: Apple’s first foldable iPhone, rumoured as the iPhone Ultra, has surfaced in a new leak with renders and key specifications. The device is tipped to feature a minimal crease, redesigned hinge, and a wider foldable design. It may include dual 48-megapixel cameras, an under-display inner camera, and a 5,800mAh battery. The phone is expected to use Apple’s A20 Pro chip with 12GB RAM and a C2 modem. It could cost over $2,000 (roughly Rs. 1,85,400), although none of these details are confirmed.
title: Apple's Foldable iPhone's Design Leaked Again; Battery Capacity Said to Surpass Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro will be offered in two more colour options, the leaked renders of the smartphone suggest. The handset could be launched in red and brown shades, in addition to the previously anticipated blue, green, and white colourways, which were spotted in purported marketing material of the smartphone. The new renders also show the phone in greater detail, suggesting that it might feature a square-shaped rear camera module, housing three camera lenses. The company is expected to bring subtle design changes to the Edge 70 Pro over its predecessor.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro Seen in New Leaked Renders That Hint at Two Additional Colour Options

description: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G and Galaxy A57 5G are now available for purchase in India. The South Korean tech conglomerate’s latest Galaxy A-series lineup was unveiled in March as the successor to the Galaxy A36 5G and Galaxy A56 5G. Both handsets feature 6.7-inch full HD+ Super AMOLED+ displays with a 120Hz refresh rate and are powered by Exynos chipsets. The duo ships with One UI 8.5 out of the box, with a promise of six generations of Android upgrades.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G, Galaxy A37 5G Go on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Oppo Find X9s Pro design was revealed by the Chinese smartphone maker on Friday. Additionally, the tech firm has revealed the colour options of the handset. The Oppo Find X9s Pro is now confirmed to be sold in China in Energetic Orange, Free White, Native Titanium, and Riding the Wind (translated from Chinese) colourways. On top of this, the smartphone is now available for pre-order via the Oppo China online store. The handset has been listed on the company website, revealing its RAM and storage configurations.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro Design, Camera Configuration and Other Key Details Revealed as Launch Date Approaches

description: Valve is reportedly working on SteamGPT, an AI-powered tool to help in Steam support issues and Counter-Strike 2 anti-cheat measures. According to a noted dataminer, the tool could also be related to Trust Score on Steam. Valve has not announced SteamGPT officially.
title: Valve Reportedly Working on SteamGPT, an AI-Powered Tool for Steam Support and Counter-Strike 2 Anti-Cheat

description: Oppo A6s Pro is set to launch in China next week. Oppo took to Weibo to confirm the arrival of the new A-series smartphones in China. This model is already available in some global markets, including Pakistan. A is confirmed to come in at least two colour options. It is already available in select markets with a MediaTek Helio G100 MAX chipset and a 6.57-inch display.
title: Oppo A6s Pro China Launch Date Announced: Expected Price, Specifications and Features

description: CMF Phone 3 Pro is said to be in the works. Ahead of the official announcement, a leak has suggested the key specifications of the phone. It will reportedly ship with the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 processor. The CMF Phone 3 Pro is said to have a typical battery capacity of 5,090mAh. It is tipped to support 45W wired charging. It could feature an AMOLED panel with 1,080x2,392 pixels resolution. The display could include a centred punch-hole front camera. The new phone will reportedly have a metal frame.
title: CMF Phone 3 Pro to Feature Snapdragon Chip and Bigger Battery With Faster Charging, Early Leak Suggests

description: Samsung will supply its next-generation Organic Light-Emitting Diode (OLED) panel for the new smartphones from Google and Apple, according to a report citing industry sources. The rumoured Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Fold could be among the first handsets to ship with this panel. The unreleased OLED panel will reportedly feature the latest M16 luminescent material. The South Korean tech conglomerate’s display division will reportedly supply the purported M16 OLED panel for other flagship smartphones, too.
title: Google Pixel 11, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple’s Foldable Will Reportedly Feature OLED Panel Supplied By Samsung

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra will launch simultaneously in China and global markets, featuring dual 200-megapixel Hasselblad-backed cameras. The setup includes enhanced light intake across sensors, a 10x telephoto lens, and a 50-megapixel ultra-wide and front camera. Oppo will also offer a professional external telephoto kit. The device is expected to feature a 6.78-inch OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, and a 7,050mAh battery. It may support satellite connectivity, multiple storage variants, and carry IP68, IP69, and IP69K ratings.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Camera Specifications Confirmed as Regulatory Listing Reveals Other Key Features

description: Samsung is said to be revising the prices of several Galaxy A- and F-series smartphones in India yet again. According to details shared by a tipster, the alleged price hike is expected to come into effect from April 10 and could impact a range of budget and mid-range models, including the Galaxy A06, Galaxy A56, and Galaxy F17. While Samsung has yet to officially announce any change in prices, the revised pricing is tipped to apply across multiple variants of select Galaxy models.
title: Samsung Galaxy A06, A56, F17 Prices Tipped to Increase in India From April 10

description: Apple has reportedly approached a US court to secure internal documents from Samsung Electronics in South Korea. The move is said to be linked to the ongoing antitrust lawsuit brought by the US Department of Justice (DOJ). The Cupertino-based tech giant seeks access to market data and internal business records, which it maintains are vital for its defence against claims of anti-competitive behaviour concerning the App Store and the iPhone ecosystem.
title: Apple Seeks Samsung South Korea’s Internal Records as App Store Practices Face DOJ Antitrust Scrutiny: Report

description: The iPhone 18 series is rumoured to launch later this year alongside Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone. In recent weeks, the rumour mill has suggested that while under-the-hood changes are expected, it may not be vastly different from the iPhone 17 Pro models in terms of design. However, fresh details about the iPhone 18 Pro suggest that Apple could be exploring changes to both the front and rear design, with the tech giant tipped to be testing multiple options.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Tipped to Feature Smaller Dynamic Island as Apple Tests Multiple Design Options
